title: Laredo Medical Center NICU Babies Celebrate Their First Thanksgiving
excerpt: The tiniest patients at Laredo Medical Center are marking Thanksgiving in hand-knitted turkey and pumpkin outfits made by volunteers from Allie's Bird Project — and NICU nurses captured the moment in photos for parents to keep.
content:
Babies in the neonatal intensive care unit at Laredo Medical Center are celebrating their first Thanksgiving, KGNS reported Thursday.

Volunteers from Allie’s Bird Project knitted turkey and pumpkin outfits for the babies, dressing the hospital’s smallest patients for the holiday.

NICU nurses then took photos of the babies in their holiday outfits as keepsakes for the parents.

Sources: KGNS — “Laredo Medical Center NICU babies celebrate first Thanksgiving”, Nov. 26, 2026, reporting by Omar Anzaldua, https://laredonews.org/news/laredo-medical-center-nicu-babies-celebrate-first-thanksgiving
